title: Web Summit Lisbon
metaDescription: Web Summit Lisbon: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Tech Events.

overview.about: Web Summit is one of the world's largest technology conferences, drawing tens of thousands of founders, investors and executives to Lisbon each November. Founded in Dublin in 2009, it moved to Portugal in 2016 and has become a defining fixture of the global tech calendar.
overview.nextEvent: The next Web Summit is held in November at Lisbon's Altice Arena and surrounding halls. Its programme spans dozens of stages on AI, venture capital, media and society, alongside a huge startup exhibition.
